module: Flowgraph node "Rally Stage Super Countdown" (timer icon, tag rally, no category). Standalone rally stage start countdown, with no dependency on the rally loop schedule: finds the start line in pathData (named position spName), measures the vehicle's proximity (signed distance to the plane, finite lateral zone of 10 m, stopped if speed < 0.08 m/s), starts a smoothed countdown (duration and number of announcements from StagedCountdownUtils.getStageCountdownSettings, defaults 3 s and 3), announces 3-2-1 then "Go!" (ScenarioFlashMessage messages, sounds, system pacenotes countdown<n>/countdowngo), unfreezes the vehicle, re-enables the pacenotes, and detects a false start (state false_start, pacenote 'falseStart'). Inputs: flow, reset (pulse), pathData, spName, vehId, distance (launch zone, 1 m by default). Outputs: flow (end, or false start), finished (pulse), ongoing, waiting, falseStart (pulse). Sends onRallyDataUpdated every frame (state countdown or vehicleProximity, rally clock).
notes: Internal states: waiting, countdown_running, launched, finished, false_start. "Go!" stays displayed for 0.1 s (GO_DISPLAY_DURATION) and the message lasts 1 s.
hasCrossedStartLine() always returns false in this file: the false start (triggerFalseStart) is therefore never triggered by this node as is.
Data options: useImgui, useMessages, bigFinishMsg (true), drawDebug.

init.desc: Initializes all state variables and data options.

_executionStarted.desc: Loads the rally loop bridge, resets the countdown and the start position cache.

reset.desc: Stops the timer and sets all outputs to false.

stopTimer.desc: Resets state, timers, rally clock and flags.

updateStartPosition.desc: Looks for the named start position in pathData (with cache) and stores pos/rot.

returns.desc: True if the position is valid.

updateVehicleData.desc: Updates the front position and speed of the tracked vehicle.

updateProximityState.desc: Computes signed distance, lateral distance, proximity, stop, "staged" and display distance.

hasCrossedStartLine.desc: Intended to detect a false start; always returns false.

drawDebugVisualization.desc: Draws the plane, the vehicle-plane line and the vehicle point if debug is active.

configureCountdownSettings.desc: Loads duration, number of announcements and visual/sound/voice options from StagedCountdownUtils.

calculateScheduledEventTime.desc: Computes the clock and the launch time of an immediate countdown (StagedCountdownUtils.calculateImmediateMinuteCountdown).

getCountdownPhase.desc: Computes the countdown phase (time remaining, integer value, announced value, progress).

updateClock.desc: Advances the countdown clock by dtSim while it is running.

getWallClockTime.desc: Simulated wall clock time (seconds) via StagedCountdownUtils.

getRallyClockData.desc: Builds the rally clock data for the UI.

unfreezeVehicle.desc: Unfreezes the vehicle (setFreeze false) via core_vehicleBridge.

returns.desc: True if a vehicle was unfrozen.

startTimer.desc: Starts the countdown: settings, launch time computation, state countdown_running.

shouldShowVisualCountdown.desc: Returns the visual countdown display setting.

enqueueSystemPacenote.desc: Queues a random system pacenote in the rally manager.

enableRallyManagerPacenoteProcessing.desc: Re-enables the pacenote processing of the rally manager.

show.desc: Displays a flash message (ScenarioFlashMessage) and optionally a UI Message.

luaCall.desc: Lua code executed by the UI (sound).

finishCountdown.desc: Ends the countdown: "Go!", sound, unfreeze, pacenotes, state launched, flow = true.

triggerFalseStart.desc: Declares a false start (log, pacenote, state false_start, flow = true).

updateCountdown.desc: Countdown state machine: 3-2-1 announcements and end.

updateGoDisplay.desc: Counts down the display of "Go!" then switches to the finished state.

sendRallyDataUpdate.desc: Broadcasts the proximity and countdown state via the onRallyDataUpdated hook.

drawMiddle.desc: Progress bar and state in the node.

work.desc: Every frame: handles reset, start position, vehicle, start, countdown, UI and outputs.
